verdict.rationale: Airwallex is API-first. It ships an official CLI for command-line use, server-side SDKs with automatic retries and token refresh, and scoped API keys for non-interactive credentials. A separate sandbox environment allows automated testing without real money, so headless automation is clearly supported. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation (e.g., non-interactive CLI auth or CI examples), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Airwallex CLI lets you work with your Airwallex account directly from a command line.
built-in error handling, automatic retries, token refresh, and support for custom requests
A scoped API key grants only the resource permissions you assign (Read or Write on specific APIs), instead of full account access.
Airwallex provides a sandbox environment, completely separate from the production environment, for testing your integration through simulations without using real money.
